label: Direct scan or simulation
summary: Visit the needed input positions or carry out the listed operations in order.

label: Hash map or set
summary: Use keys to look up stored values or counts; use a set to test whether a value has been seen.

label: Two pointers
summary: Track two positions or node references and move them according to the values being compared.

label: Sliding window
summary: Track a contiguous part of the input, adding at its right end and removing from its left end.

label: Binary search
summary: Compare a middle candidate, then eliminate the half that cannot contain the answer.

label: Stack
summary: Process the most recently added item first, removing it from the top of the stack.

label: Monotonic stack or deque
summary: Keep stack or deque values in increasing or decreasing order by removing entries that break that order.

label: Queue simulation
summary: Add items at the back and process them from the front, in the order they arrived.

label: Heap / priority queue
summary: Keep the smallest or largest available item at the top so it can be selected as items are added and removed.

label: Quickselect partitioning
summary: Split values around a pivot, then continue only in the part containing the requested sorted position.

label: Prefix / suffix accumulation
summary: Store sums, products, or counts accumulated before or after positions so those totals can be reused.

label: Candidate cancellation
summary: Increase support for matching candidate values and cancel that support when competing values appear.

label: Value-to-index placement
summary: Place each allowed value at the array index assigned to that value, then inspect missing or repeated placements.

label: Linked-list pointer updates
summary: Save the next node before changing a link so the unprocessed list stays reachable.

label: Fast and slow pointers
summary: Move one pointer one step and another two steps to detect a cycle or identify a list position.

label: Indexed state with recency / frequency
summary: Look up entries by key and track access order or access counts to decide which entry to remove.

label: Depth-first traversal
summary: Follow one branch as far as needed before returning to explore the next branch.

label: Breadth-first traversal
summary: Use a queue to visit all nodes in the current distance layer before nodes one edge farther away.

label: Binary search tree ordering
summary: Use the rule that left-subtree values are smaller and right-subtree values are larger than a node.

label: Divide and conquer
summary: Split the input into smaller parts, solve those parts, and combine their answers.

label: Backtracking
summary: Choose an option, explore the choices after it, then undo it before trying another option.

label: Trie / prefix tree
summary: Store words along shared character-by-character paths, with markers for complete words.

label: Topological ordering
summary: Start with nodes that have no unmet prerequisites, then reduce the remaining prerequisites of their dependents.

label: Weighted path optimization
summary: Compare route costs through neighboring nodes and update a best-known cost when a cheaper route is found.

label: Minimum spanning tree
summary: Connect all graph nodes with the minimum total edge cost, without adding cycles.

label: Dynamic programming
summary: Store answers to smaller repeated problems and use those answers when computing larger ones.

label: Expand around centers
summary: Start at a character or a gap between characters and extend outward while the two sides match.

label: Greedy invariant
summary: Choose the best currently available option using a rule that keeps an optimal final answer possible.

label: Ordered interval processing
summary: Process start and end positions in order to identify overlaps, gaps, and completed intervals.

label: Arithmetic or counting identity
summary: Compute the result using arithmetic relationships, digit positions, or counting formulas.

label: Bit manipulation
summary: Inspect and change binary digits using AND, OR, XOR, masks, and shifts.

label: Eulerian edge traversal
summary: Use each graph edge once and finish a node only after its unused outgoing edges have been explored.

label: Sort candidates by priority
summary: Sort the available items by the needed priority and take the first item, repeating as the available set changes.

label: Union-find components
summary: Track each connected group by a representative, merging representatives when a new connection joins two groups.
